headline: Resolute Mining Output Slips to 31,800 Ounces at Mali Syama Mine
summary: Resolute Mining produced 31,777 ounces at its Syama gold mine in Mali in the September quarter following security and explosives challenges.
why: Resolute Mining is an Australian-listed gold producer operating in West Africa, where geopolitical and operational risks frequently impact production targets.

impacts.name: Resolute Mining
impacts.why: Quarterly gold production at its flagship Syama mine was constrained by explosives and security issues.
